rule hash `395db7daea98`.

**Advertised boundary.** `AXES["palette_size"]` declares integer values `2..4`,
but `generate()` always samples exactly three colors directly from its layout RNG
and never consumes this override through `GenCtx`.

**One retained valid/invalid comparison.** With the ticket seed and sample index 0,
the baseline call, valid `palette_size=2`, and invalid `palette_size=999` were all
accepted. All three produced byte-identical grids (grid SHA-256
`d600e032b11e1141240b386d0287fddac4692c5585a969d868b6d34a58e9ee98`) and all
three retained an observed palette size of 3.

**Impact.** Callers cannot rely on the advertised axis to vary palette size or to
reject out-of-domain values. This is an API/axis-honesty defect, not evidence that
the canonical transformation itself is wrong.

**Evidence.** `checks/tickets/ticket-30fe1ef4c0aed250/result.json` contains the
three exact calls, returned grids, hashes, and pinned source identity;
`probe.py` is the reproducer. No peer source was edited. The finding is bounded to
one source, seed, sample, and advertised axis and remains reviewer-reported pending
maintainer assessment.
